Credit bundles, currencies, tax treatment, payment methods, unit pricing and any included entitlements will be disclosed before purchase. An eligible new user may receive a one-time award of 50 Promotional Credits following qualifying registration, if and while this offer is displayed. Sharing an IP address or household alone does not conclusively establish misuse. We do not guarantee identical promotional offers in all countries or at all times.

Before a chargeable generation starts, we will display its applicable credit cost. Deduction must be recorded against a unique transaction or generation request to prevent duplicate charging. A checkbox or notice will be designed for the specific transaction rather than relying solely on general acceptance of these Terms. Approved refunds are normally returned to the original payment method. We will disclose a workable support route and respond to billing disputes without imposing an unlawful notice cutoff.
